system.creatureSubtype: Huge size, Powerful Build; immune to lightning damage; does not need air, food, drink, or sleep
system.tactics: Tempest Giants open with Lightning Bolt to soften clustered enemies, then close to melee using Storm Step to arrive at the perfect angle.
system.attacksNotes:
Wind-Forged Greatclub [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 5), Reach: 15 ft

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 lightning damage (Half DR)
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage; target is pushed 15 feet
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage; target pushed 15 feet and knocked Prone

Lightning Bolt [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 4), Range: 120 ft, 5-foot-wide line

  • Margin 1:: 16 lightning damage (12 + 4 Dex)
  • Margin 2: 16 lightning damage, DR halved (round up)
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Storm Step (Recharge 6-8): As a [Move] action, the Tempest Giant teleports up to 60 feet and arrives in a crack of thunder. All creatures within 10 feet of its arrival point make a Fortitude save (1 success) or be knocked Prone. Powerful Build. Counts as Gigantic for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Wind Wall (1/day): As 2 [Combat] actions, create a 60-foot-long, 20-foot-high wall of roaring wind that persists for 1 minute. Ranged ### Attacks through the wall add 2 to both dice. Small and Tiny creatures cannot pass through it. The Tempest Giant can dismiss it as a [Free] action.
